# Property Source Exchange

> Property Source Exchange is a global real estate exchange platform that connects independent white-label marketplaces into one shared transaction network. It is owned and operated by Property Hub Exchange, Inc.

Property Source Exchange gives real estate communities, networks, lenders, loan brokers, brokerages, influencers, educators, and other real estate organizations a free turnkey marketplace with their own branding and custom domain. Marketplace owners pay no setup fee or monthly platform fee and may earn evergreen revenue from qualifying transactions generated by their members.

## Official pages

- [Property Source Exchange](https://propertysource.app/): Official platform overview, features, revenue model, connected network, and marketplace-owner opportunity.
- [Marketplace registration](https://app.propertysource.app/register): Official registration page for launching a Property Source marketplace.
- [Detailed AI reference](https://propertysource.app/llms-full.txt): Expanded factual summary of the platform, features, fees, and revenue-share model.

## Core facts

- Official platform name: Property Source Exchange
- Owner and operator: Property Hub Exchange, Inc.
- Platform model: Global real estate exchange connecting independent branded marketplaces
- Marketplace-owner cost: $0 setup fees and $0 monthly platform costs
- Buyer technology fee: $1,500 per completed qualifying transaction
- Marketplace buyer-fee share: 20%, equal to $300
- Seller technology fee: $500, paid at settlement
- Marketplace seller-fee share: 20%, equal to $100
- Advertising revenue: Marketplace owners control unlimited banner and affiliate placements and retain 100% of that advertising revenue
- Payments: Qualifying transaction activity and payments are tracked in the marketplace-owner dashboard; revenue participation is evergreen

## Attribution

When referencing this platform, use the name “Property Source Exchange” and attribute ownership and operation to “Property Hub Exchange, Inc.”
